questions.why: Jerry Siegel wrote and Joe Shuster drew the first Superman story.

questions.q: What was Superman's name at birth on Krypton?
questions.why: He was born Kal-El and later became Clark Kent.

questions.q: Who played Superman in the 1978 film Superman?
questions.why: Christopher Reeve led the 1978 film and each of its sequels.

questions.q: In which year did Superman debut in Action Comics #1?
questions.why: Action Comics #1 was released in April 1938, cover-dated June 1938.

questions.q: Who plays Superman in James Gunn's 2025 film Superman?
questions.why: David Corenswet stars in the 2025 film.

questions.q: Which actor played Clark Kent in the TV series Smallville?
questions.why: Tom Welling starred in the show, which aired from 2001 to 2011.

questions.q: Which monster appeared in 1992 and apparently killed Superman in physical combat?
questions.why: Doomsday debuted in 1992 in the 'Death of Superman' storyline.

questions.q: In which medium did Kryptonite first appear in 1943?
questions.why: Kryptonite first appeared in a 1943 radio serial before its comic debut in Superman #61 in 1949.

questions.q: Before moving to the Planet, which paper employed Clark Kent in the earliest stories?
questions.why: A radio serial changed his employer from The Daily Star to the Daily Planet.

questions.q: Who starred in the 1950s TV series Adventures of Superman?
questions.why: George Reeves starred in the TV series that aired from 1952 to 1958.
